note: The A0 regression suite for kit edits. Kit edits cannot be byte-gated (the model is nondeterministic even at temperature 0), so this is their harness: author every prompt once, before and after, and score the deltas. Seven prompts are the battery's own families, so a run is directly comparable to the WS-C corpus statistics. Seeds are the battery's seeds where a family has one, so a golden run and an archived battery world differ by kit bytes and compiler build alone.
